newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares close in optimistic mood.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares close in optimistic mood.

text.p: 1800 GMT - Shares closed higher and look set to gain again on Thursday if Wall Street continued positive, traders said.
*Only Cimpor and Soares da Costa buck the buoyant trend in which banks and telecoms took the lead.
*Cimpor was hit by the start of trade in shares sold to small investors at its privatisation six months ago, while Soares da Costa lost on a sharp drop in profit last year.
*The PSI20 .PSI20 ended 0.22 percent higher at 6,141.53 with futures gaining slightly more to close 38 points up at 6,147.
